neighbours.label: ' to' after 'nearest' or 'closest' (being near a location)
fire: Pick the pharmacy nearest to your home for quick refills.
The campsite closest to the lake fills up first.
We booked the hotel nearest to the stadium.
Sit in the seat closest to the exit if you feel unwell.
Use the data centre nearest to your customers.
The village closest to the border has a small market.
Park in the lot nearest to the north entrance.
The table closest to the window has the best light.
quiet: Pick a pharmacy with long hours for quick refills.
The campsite by the lake fills up first.
We booked the hotel a month before the game.
Sit in the back row if you feel unwell.
Use a data centre with good backup power.
The village has a small market on Sundays.
Park in the north lot and walk to the entrance.
The table by the window has the best light.
